# PetAssistant

> AI pet care assistant for dog and cat owners. Ask anything about food, health or training and get a clear answer in seconds. Free forever for 1 pet, no credit card needed.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://petassists.com/): what PetAssistant is and what it does
- [Pricing](https://petassists.com/pricing): Free forever plan, 29 EUR lifetime, 49 EUR Pro Family
- [Create a free account](https://petassists.com/signup): no credit card required
- [Contact](https://petassists.com/contact): support
- [Terms of service](https://petassists.com/terms)
- [Privacy policy](https://petassists.com/privacy)
- [Refund policy](https://petassists.com/refund): 30-day guarantee on the lifetime plan

## About
- PetAssistant helps owners organise pet care: instant AI answers, food and medicine label scanning, health records and reminders.
- It does not diagnose conditions and does not replace a veterinarian.
- Publisher: DUAL DELIGHT SRL (Romania). Website: https://petassists.com
